chunks: Abū ʿAlī al-Arrajānī al-Fārisī narrated to me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:

I asked ʿAbd al-Raḥmān in the year in which Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī (عليه السلام) was seized, and I said to him: This man has come into the hands of this one, and we do not know what will become of him; so has anything reached you from him regarding any one of his sons?

So he said to me: I had not thought that anyone would ask me about this matter. I entered upon Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad in his house, and there he was in a room in his residence, in a mosque belonging to him, and he was making duʿa, while on his right was Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), saying Āmīn to his supplication.

So I said to him: May Allah make me your ransom; you know my devotion to you and my service to you, so who is the wali of the people after you? He said: Mūsā has put on the armor and it fit him evenly. So I said to him: After this, I have no need for anything else.

key_terms.أُخِذَ: was seized or taken into custody
key_terms.الدِّرْعَ: the armor, used here as a sign of fitness and succession
key_terms.وَلِيُّ: guardian or divinely designated authority over the people
key_terms.يُؤَمِّنُ: was saying Āmīn in response to the du'a

ai.seo_question: What evidence in al-Kāfī indicates the Imamate of Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) after Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith records a report used as an indication of the Imamate of Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) after Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad (عليه السلام). It describes a direct question about the successor and presents the Imam’s symbolic statement that Mūsā had worn the armor and it fit him properly, conveying readiness and rightful succession.

en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad who said, ‘Abu Ali Al Arjany Al Farsy narrated to me, from Abdul Rahman Al Hajjaj who said,

‘I asked Abdul Rahman during the year in which Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) was seized (imprisoned), and I said to him, ‘This man<sup>asws</sup> who has come to be in the hands of this one (the Caliph), and we do not know what would become of him<sup>asws</sup>. So has there reached anything from him<sup>asws</sup> regarding any one of his<sup>asws</sup> sons?’

So he said to me, ‘I had not thought anyone would be asking me about this issue. I had gone to Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> house, so there he<sup>asws</sup> was in a room of his<sup>asws</sup> house in a Masjid of his<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was supplicating, and upon his<sup>asws</sup> right hand was Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, saying, ‘Ameen’, upon his<sup>asws</sup> supplication’.

So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Make me to be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! You<sup>asws</sup> have recognised my cutting-off (from others) to you<sup>asws</sup>, and my service to you<sup>asws</sup>. So who would be the Guardian of the people after you<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Musa<sup>asws</sup> had worn the armour and it fit evenly upon him<sup>asws</sup>’. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I am not needy after this, to anything’.
en.sarwar: 3. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad who has said the following. “Abu Ali al-Arjani al-Farisi narrated to me from ‘Abd al-Rahman al- Hajjaj

in the year ( 179 AH /795 AD) in which former abu al-Hasan, Imam Musa (a.s.) was detained. I (Hajjaj) said to him (‘Abd al-Rahman), “This man (abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) has been detained in his (Mansur, current ruler) hands. We do not know how his conditions are. Have you heard anything from him about his sons?”

He (‘Abd al-Rahman) said to me, “I did not think anyone would ask me about this issue. Once I went to see Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) in his home. He was in such and such a room at the prayer area. He was praying to Allah and on his right side was Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.) saying Amen for his prayer.

I said to him, ‘May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, you know my having cutoff from all others to serve you, who will be the Wali Leader with Divine Authority for people after you?” He replied, “Musa has dressed up in this coat of arms and it has perfectly fitted him.” I then said to him, “I will not need anything after this.”
